verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents multiple distinct agents. Each has an Agent Builder with control over Skills, an editable Markdown profile, and its own persistent memory, and agents can be added and customized in a Workspace. It also ships an IM Gateway / Messenger with Telegram, Slack and Discord to bring agents into chat channels. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-agent model selection, per-agent isolated workspaces (the docs describe a shared team Workspace), documented routing of specific channels or conversations to specific agents, and independent hands-on corroboration.
